title: •Sabotage
caption: •Sabotage (V)
game_text: Target an opponent’s device or non-superlaser weapon card. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny -X < target’s destiny number, where X = the number of your spies on table. OR Cancel the targeting of a {permanent-weapon} weapon at same site as your spy.
lore: Poorly equipped Rebels must rely on clandestine strikes against the massive Imperial military. Computer ‘slicing’ and system tampering have proven most effective.

notes: Slip banner is LOST INTERRUPT (printed card is a Used Interrupt). Inline icon is a black square with a diagonal green-tipped blaster = the permanent-weapon icon ({permanent-weapon}); wiki stub just says [weapon]. 'destiny -X' printed with a plain hyphen, no space. Lore 'slicing' in single quotes on the card (typed curly). Only a 350 px base scan; copyright year taken as 1996 (A New Hope), not legible.
